text:
## Red Flags During Customer Interaction  
**Be Alert If Customer:**
- Seems coached or nervous
- Can't explain purpose of transaction
- Uses unusual channels or amounts
- Third party is present and controlling conversation
- Requests cash immediately after deposit  
**Be Alert If Teller Colleague:**
- Bypasses controls
- Works unusual hours alone
- Has access they shouldn't have
- Makes undocumented exceptions
name: Chunk 38/61

raw_entities.name: Customer Appears Coached or Nervous During Interaction
raw_entities.description: A behavioral red flag indicating a customer may be acting under external pressure or instruction during a banking interaction. This sign suggests potential money laundering, fraud, or account takeover activity where the customer is not acting of their own volition.

raw_entities.name: Customer Unable to Explain Transaction Purpose
raw_entities.description: A red flag indicating a customer cannot or will not articulate a legitimate business or personal reason for a transaction. This suggests potential money laundering, structuring, or other illicit activity.

raw_entities.name: Customer Uses Unusual Channels or Transaction Amounts
raw_entities.description: A red flag when a customer deviates from their established banking patterns by using unexpected payment methods or transaction sizes. This may indicate structuring, layering, or other suspicious financial activity.

raw_entities.name: Third Party Present and Controlling Customer Conversation
raw_entities.description: A red flag when a third party is physically present during a customer interaction and appears to be directing or controlling the customer's statements and decisions. This suggests potential fraud, coercion, or money laundering.
context: Third party is present and controlling conversation

raw_entities.name: Customer Requests Immediate Cash Withdrawal After Deposit
raw_entities.description: A red flag indicating a customer deposits funds and immediately requests cash withdrawal, suggesting potential money laundering, structuring, or layering activity. This pattern is commonly used to obscure the source or destination of illicit funds.

raw_entities.name: Teller Colleague Bypasses Internal Controls
raw_entities.description: A red flag indicating a colleague is deliberately circumventing established internal controls or procedures. This suggests potential fraud, collusion, or unauthorized activity.

raw_entities.name: Teller Colleague Works Unusual Hours Alone
raw_entities.description: A red flag indicating a colleague is working outside normal business hours without supervision or oversight. This creates opportunity for unauthorized transactions, fraud, or other misconduct.

raw_entities.name: Teller Colleague Has Unauthorized System Access
raw_entities.description: A red flag indicating a colleague has access to systems, accounts, or functions beyond what their role requires. This creates risk of unauthorized transactions, data theft, or fraud.

raw_entities.name: Teller Colleague Makes Undocumented Exceptions
raw_entities.description: A red flag indicating a colleague is processing transactions or making decisions outside normal procedures without creating an audit trail or documentation. This suggests potential fraud, collusion, or deliberate concealment.

properties.name: Customer Appears Coached or Nervous During Interaction

properties.description: Customer displays signs of being coached or appears nervous during banking interaction
properties.required_action: Pause transaction and assess situation; escalate if concerns persist

properties.name: Customer Unable to Explain Transaction Purpose

properties.description: Customer cannot or will not provide clear explanation for the purpose of their transaction
properties.required_action: Request detailed explanation; do not proceed if explanation remains unclear

properties.name: Customer Uses Unusual Channels or Transaction Amounts

properties.description: Customer conducts transactions through atypical channels or uses amounts inconsistent with their profile
properties.required_action: Verify transaction details and customer profile; document deviation

properties.name: Third Party Present and Controlling Customer Conversation

properties.description: A third party is present during the transaction and appears to be directing or controlling the customer's actions or responses
properties.required_action: Request to speak with customer privately; pause transaction if customer appears coerced

properties.name: Customer Requests Immediate Cash Withdrawal After Deposit

properties.description: Customer deposits funds and immediately requests withdrawal of cash, suggesting potential structuring or layering activity
properties.required_action: Question the purpose; document the pattern; consider filing SAR if suspicious

properties.description: Colleague circumvents established internal control procedures or approval processes
properties.required_action: Report immediately to management; do not participate in bypassed controls
properties.escalation_path: Branch manager, compliance officer, or internal audit

properties.name: Teller Colleague Works Unusual Hours Alone

properties.description: Colleague regularly works outside normal business hours or operates alone without supervision
properties.required_action: Report pattern to management; verify business justification

properties.name: Teller Colleague Has Unauthorized System Access

properties.description: Colleague possesses system access or permissions beyond what their role requires
properties.required_action: Report to IT security and management immediately
properties.escalation_path: IT security, branch manager, or compliance officer

properties.description: Colleague processes transactions or approves actions without proper documentation or audit trail
properties.required_action: Request documentation; escalate if colleague refuses or cannot provide records
properties.escalation_path: Branch manager, compliance officer, or internal audit
